title: clematis viorna subsp. reticulata
intro: Clematis viorna subsp. reticulata, commonly known as Virgin's Bower, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Clematis genus. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which can also help to relieve pain and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Clematis viorna subsp. reticulata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
